title: Canonical Scope Manifest v1 (scope-bound watch token)
description: The manifest document carried by a scope-bound watch token (Ruling A, doc 01 §5.5, doc 11 §3.2): the canonical RoE target scope — domains, CIDRs, exclusions — resolved by gatekeeper roe-service at activation (doc 11 §3.1). The manifest is serialized canonically with JCS (RFC 8785, doc 01 §10.2) before hashing; sha256(JCS(manifest)) IS the token claim targets.manifest_sha256 and the audit value "scope:sha256:<hash>". The agent SDK/PEP evaluates each probe target against this scope using doc 01 §10.1's canonicalized matching (longest-prefix/exact-host); explicit_excludes ALWAYS WIN over every include form. Fail-closed: a scan job without a valid in-scope token is dead-lettered and audit-logged.

roe_id.description: RoE this scope was resolved from.

roe_version.description: RoE version the scope binds to; PEPs re-validate and halt on version change.

scope.description: The canonical RoE scope (doc 11 §3.1). explicit_excludes always win over includes — enforced at decision time and per-probe in the SDK.

asset_group_ids.description: Asset groups from the data platform (module 09) included in scope.

explicit_excludes.description: Hard exclusions (hosts, IPs, CIDRs) — always win over every include form.
